about: The reviewed client checks by role name (ADR-0059 decision 7, story R0.13), read by roleNameLiterals.test.ts. Decisions: kept (tests the name on purpose), compat (kept for compatibility; none left since R0.8c, issue 2586, removed the single admin_role field, its AdminRole type and the single-role picker), project (a project role name, which ADR-0059 does not change), unrelated (not a role name). The server never trusts any of these: it tests admin.auth.users.super_admin.

sites.why: The default project role offered when adding a project member: the project role admin, not an administration role.
The revocation reason of a device session (revoke_reason admin), not a role.
